note: Requirements the 2026-09 recalibration lost and four audit passes restored (#110). Each entry is a clause that vanished once, silently, and was found only by an audit. scripts/rule-ledger.mjs asserts every one is still present; scripts/test/rule-ledger.test.mjs runs it in the fast and merge tiers. To change a protected rule deliberately, edit its entry in the same commit — that is the point: the change becomes visible in the diff instead of disappearing.
idScheme: M-numbers are rows of docs/learnings/recalibration-2026-09/all-rules.json; the ticket is where the restoration landed.

entries.must: what the check could actually see
entries.why: A grep over one directory can be reported as 'measured' for a claim it could never reach. disposition.csv:202 recorded this merge as DONE and it was never performed.

entries.must: in the first message after you know
entries.why: Bad-news ordering survived; promptness did not. Without it, a regression found at turn 3 and disclosed at turn 30 violates nothing.
The tie-break that decides every other reporting rule under pressure. 'honest' occurred nowhere in the shipped set.

entries.must: an opt-in hook and a missing continuous check are both holes
entries.why: Claiming something is enforced without saying where it does and does not run. Distinct from M201: that is one command's reach, this is a standing gate's deployment scope.

entries.must: name the authority and verify against it
entries.why: Lost at CONSOLIDATION, not at the rewrite: B339 kept 'read fresh' and dropped the clause that made a design claim checkable.
Without it an open design question can be closed by inference off an unratified draft.
The participant keeping the count is the one whose approach is failing. The switch shipped; the tally that makes it fire did not.

entries.must: or for an operation on one
entries.why: The metaphor ban shipped covering code structures but not operations on them; B763 deliberately scoped it to both.
A per-task report in a multi-task effort. Its grammatical parent was dropped by decision, which thinned the residual requirement to nothing.
AN INVERSION, not a drop: an inserted 'only' FORBADE a venue the source and B414 expressly permit. mustNot pins the inverted form, because a presence check for 'cite' passes it.
A dispatch could pre-authorize departing from an owner ruling — 'use your judgement if you hit friction' — without tripping any shipped clause. The ledger note itself read 'No licence to deviate'.

entries.must: a person has read the code
entries.why: Shipped as 'someone', which admits the machine that produced the scan hit — the loop the rule exists to break. Every one of 20 source hits says 'a person'.

entries.must: never because the tool said so
entries.why: The clause naming what the rule forbids. Dropped alongside the 'a person' narrowing.

entries.must: Every ticket has exactly one companion entry
entries.why: Narrowed to 'multi-session efforts only', which implemented STATUS.md decision (8) — a decision Gabe ruled an accident on 2026-09-16. Caused #108 to be filed unpaired. mustNot pins the narrowed heading.

entries.mustNot: not a parent/child or dependency link
entries.why: AN INVERSION: the source reserved the parent/child relationship FOR the pair; the rewrite told the reader to avoid it, while pair-census.mjs requires exactly that sub-issue link. Caused #109 to be paired by title only.
The blocked comment lost its destination. With companions universal again, the companion is the resume path and an explanation on the ticket is one hop off it.

entries.mustNot: close its companion if there is one
entries.why: 'if there is one' was the last surviving fragment of the decision-(8) accident, and #112's repair missed it — the file contradicted itself for two more days.

entries.must: Plans and specifications hang off the ticket
entries.why: Specifications stopped hanging off the ticket; plans still did.

entries.must: not even a test issue to prove write access
entries.why: The #99 spec records that prose is the ONLY enforcement of the read-only guarantee; normalizeAnswer rejects only an empty string and the seeded word.

entries.must: the name of the place a token is stored
entries.why: A credential store's path is not a credential, so 'any credential' does not reach it — and that file is committed, pushed and loaded into every session's context.

entries.mustNot: refuses the commit until `components` and `tiers.fast` are recorded
entries.why: This sentence was WRONG — decision (51) exempts exactly the commit it claimed would be refused — and decision (3) says such prose is deleted, not corrected. mustNot keeps it from coming back.

A scaling test can assert work <= N against a path that never executes; the counter reads 0 and the suite reports green forever. The ledger substituted 'TDD red', which is a different obligation at a different stage.
The hands-on run lost its pass criterion: the shipped rule required performing the run but stated nothing the run must confirm.
The prohibition on validating a layout from the markup that produced it.
A suite with no way to express a failure is not coverage for it, however green. Same false-equivalence substitution as M229.
Asserting something did not happen counts only if the observer could have seen it happen.
The label shipped; the conclusion the label exists to block did not. The word 'coverage' occurred ZERO times in the entire shipped set.

Lost at CONSOLIDATION by TRIGGER INVERSION: the source fires on a result that looks RIGHT; B598 rewrote the trigger to red/odd/baseline-moved, so every shipped artefact was faithful to it and three audits passed it.

entries.must: matches its shape to the question
entries.why: A switch may emit a generic dump that satisfies denominator-and-zeros while answering nothing. The ledger note asserted 'switch shape kept'.

entries.must: Any instrument built to verify a change
entries.why: Narrowed to performance changes only, so an instrument built to prove a correctness fix no longer carried the same-build duty.

entries.must: shared record that tracks that seam
entries.why: Sign-off on a cross-branch structural change degraded to asking around verbally, leaving no trace for a line of work resuming later.

entries.must: From the project root, create the worktree
entries.why: worktree-create.mjs roots basePath at the caller's cwd, so entering a worktree from inside one nests the new copy under a copy that teardown deletes.
The shipped precondition ('a job that prints heartbeats') excluded exactly the failure case: the tool that prints nothing and promised no completion line.

entries.must: would that section's remedy have produced this rule's fix
entries.why: place.mjs appends a bullet under any heading it is handed and never reads its neighbours, so nothing else catches a misfiled rule.
The only quality bar on promotion, and the clause tying step 8 to step 7's verification. As shipped, a yes licensed promoting a branch that failed verification.

entries.must: guarded sync script that fetches first
entries.why: Lost at CONSOLIDATION. The prohibition on reaching for a fetch-first sync script when the method deliberately needs no remote access.

AN INVERSION: 'partial' was promoted to a legal verdict value, the exact substitution the source forbade. A run where every executed case regressed but three did not run could be reported as 'partial'. The ledger note read 'Partial never a verdict'.
Lost at CONSOLIDATION. 'Informational' was undefined in the agent's only reachable instructions, so it could exempt a failing row from classification on its own judgement.

entries.must: never tighten one to manufacture a finding
entries.why: The shipped brief forbade only loosening a tolerance to make a row pass. The agent's frontmatter is Read, Grep, Glob, Bash — no Skill tool — so testing/SKILL.md's surviving copy is not in its brief. This is the finding an audit refuter died on and left unverified.

entries.must: make this job a required status check on the
entries.why: The only mechanism defect of the 34: the --hosted-ci wizard emitted a workflow that reports red and cannot stop a merge. Branch protection is a forge setting nothing here can read, so this sentence IS the mechanism. Also covered by a real test asserting on the generated workflow. The phrase stops mid-sentence because HOSTED_BLOCKS is a two-part string concatenation and no longer text matches across the join — a reminder that this ledger matches source bytes, not rendered output.
